450:t_000:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, be alert. The $$宇宙怪獣$$ will soon be in combat range.」

450:t_000:46.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ランスロー$$ says it's an army unlike anything we've ever seen.」

450:t_000:47.en:
$$シモン$$
「If they're launching an all-out attack, we have to meet it head-on.」

450:t_000:48.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn right. There's no need to hold back against $$バアル$$.」

450:t_000:50.en:
$n
「Are you seeing the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ in the $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

450:t_000:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「But the enemy will attack without question. If we hesitate, we will be the ones to die.」

450:t_000:54.en:
$$赤木$$
「Maybe things would change if we knew what the $$宇宙怪獣$$ really were, or could talk to them.」

450:t_000:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You never know. We might talk to them and find they're monstrous villains like Emperor Zuul.」

450:t_000:56.en:
$$刹那$$
「But even so, if we could understand one another...」

450:t_000:58.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't worry, $$ヒイロ$$. I haven't forgotten what we need to do now.」

450:t_000:60.en:
$$渓$$
「So the decisive battle is finally here!」

450:t_001:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'd heard about it, but there are so many!」

450:t_001:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It looks like they're all $$太陽系限定種$$.」

450:t_001:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I'll take the lead! I'm used to fighting them!」

450:t_002:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Has worrying about $$ノノ$$... made her lose her head...!?」

450:t_002:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
(If these things were gone, $$ノノ$$ wouldn't have to force herself to fight...! Then we could always be together...!)

450:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, support $$ラルク$$! We're intercepting the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

450:t_002:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go, $$ディスヌフ$$! If they want a decisive battle, I'll give them one!」

450:t_005:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「Is my $$バスターマシン$$ frightened...?」

450:t_005:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Hey...! What's wrong, $$ヴァンセット$$!?」

450:t_005:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you doing, $$ディスヌフ$$!? Move already!」

450:t_005:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's going on!? What's happening to them!?」

450:t_005:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ラルク$$'s $$バスターマシン$$s have something like a will of their own... Are they sensing something...?」

450:t_005:8.en:
$$凱$$
「Gravitational field anomaly detected! Something's warping in!」

450:t_006:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「The Space Emperor didn't summon them this time, so they've finally launched a real invasion of the solar system!」

450:t_006:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It'll be trouble if they join up with the $$太陽系限定種$$! We need to hurry and...」

450:t_007:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What's going on!? Aren't they all $$宇宙怪獣$$!?」

450:t_008:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「They're heading for those other $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

450:t_008:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Are they fighting each other!?」

450:t_009:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But... maybe the $$宇宙怪獣$$ I know and the ones $$ラルク$$ knows are completely different creatures...」

450:t_009:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ from parallel worlds recognize each other as enemies...!?」

450:t_009:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll think about it later! They're targeting us next!」

450:t_009:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. The $$宇宙怪獣$$' combat capabilities exceed the data in this unit's possession.」

450:t_009:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you saying they've been strengthened!?」

450:t_010:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The embodiments of endless destruction before you were born for the true ending that comes once every 120 million years.」

450:t_010:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Their existence has a different meaning from those summoned by the embodiment of cosmic darkness in the previous battle.」

450:t_010:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You could say they herald the beginning of the end.」

450:t_010:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You bastard! Are you planning to watch from up there!?」

450:t_010:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am not that free. I have somewhere I must go.」

450:t_010:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have no use for the green planet with its scarred land. It is the blue planet I want.」

450:t_010:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Stay there and savor the end of the universe.」

450:t_011:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Calm down, $$アマタ$$! Fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ comes first right now!」

450:t_011:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I think they're probably an advance force! If we don't stop them here, they'll keep coming one after another!」

450:t_011:5.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes! I have something I want to protect too!」

450:t_011:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$ガンバスター$$ has only one wing, and the $$バスターマシン$$s are frightened...)

450:t_011:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Can $c win when we're worn out from one battle after another...?)

450:t_013:1.en:
$$凱$$
「Are you kidding me!? These are the main force!?」
